description: Use this when you need to download a catalog part as a STEP file. Resolve an id (or single-match query) to a part record and write its STEP file to the local cache. Bundled ids resolve offline; non-bundled ids require partsBaseUrl (or KERNELCAD_PARTS_BASE_URL). Returns the cache path plus a sha256 fingerprint.

partsBaseUrl.description: Opt-in remote endpoint; no default value ships with kernelCAD.

name: fetch_part

cachePath.description: Local cache path of the written STEP file (success).

disclosure.description: Referral disclosure. Present only when url carries a referral tag; show it with the link.

instruction.description: What to do with the link_out URL.

kind.description: 'link_out' when the URL is a vendor configurator the agent must drive by hand.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the STEP file (success).

url.description: Outbound vendor URL (link_out). May carry a referral tag; see disclosure.

title: Fetch Part
